Obituary

J. Ronald Pengilly

5/5/1934 – 9/28/2026

Piedmont Post · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

J. Ronald (Ron) Pengilly passed peacefully on September 28, 2026. Ron was born on May 5, 1934 to Joseph and Lillian Pengilly in Montebello, CA where he was raised. He leaves behind his beloved wife of 67 years, Margaret Ann (Margy) Pengilly, his daughter, Kathryn Ann Pengilly, son James W. Pengilly and seven grandchildren.

Ron was a straight A student throughout high school and college. He attended UCLA where he was a member of the Phi Beta Kappa academic honorary society and the Phi Gamma Delta fraternity while participating in student government. Boalt Law School (now named UC Berkeley Law) came next. While at Boalt he won the state Moot Court championship. During his law school years, he worked as a “hasher” at the Kappa Alpha Theta sorority where he met his future wife, Margy.

They were married in 1959 after they both graduated. In 1961, they moved to Piedmont where they raised their children and have lived for over 60 years.

Ron joined a small law firm in San Francisco after passing the bar in 1959. He was only the 5th person to join. The firm grew rapidly and changed names several times and expanded nation and worldwide. Pettit and Martin became its permanent name.

Ron’s specialty was real estate law at which he excelled. Examples of his successes include the Transamerica Pyramid, Rossmoor, and the relocation of the San Francisco produce market. He loved his law practice.

In retirement he enjoyed having more time to be with his family, traveling, reading, and playing bridge and golf with friends.

Private services for the family will be held.

For those who have asked please make donations to the charity of your choice.
